thread:
marc: Heads-up — nightly perf CI (nightly-run/seq-latency) jumped ~15% vs baseline around 03:10 UTC. ci-bot flagged regression. Can someone take first pass triage? :eyes:

ci-bot: [alert] perf/regression detected on nightly-run-2026-03-16 build 1825001100. Summary: p50 latency +15%, small-batch path. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.local/build/1825001100/logs (artifacts retained)

devon: I can grab the job artifacts, linking flamegraph if present. marc can you paste the failing bench name?

marc: bench name is `inference/throughput/small_batch_seq`. Short repro is in the job: run with --seq 512 --batch 4.

anya: pinging @kai for profiling — last change to kernel selection landed in the same window (PR #3216). Could be related.

kai: looking. I started a quick local run against the same sha (c7f9d2e). Small-batch p50 went up ~12% for me. Repro is consistent.

marc: thanks. can you run the perf profiler and upload flamegraphs? example:```bash
PYTHONPATH=. python -m perf.run --bench small_batch_seq --sha c7f9d2e --profiler=flamegraph --out /tmp/fg.svg
```

kai: running now. also checking GPU metrics — tessa, did autoscaler change or any infra rollouts overnight?

tessa: no autoscaler changes. infra did a kubelet restart on one node at 02:50 UTC but marked healthy. No driver updates. I left logs in infra-ops.

devon: uploaded raw perf artifacts to https://ci.redwood.local/artifacts/1825001100/ — includes latency histograms, pprof, and the runner stdout.

kai: flamegraph looks like CPU time shifted to attention kernel selection codegen, not NV kernel. Attaching snippet:```text
hot spots:
  runtime/kernel/attention_codegen.py: line 214
  runtime/kernel/selection.py: line 87
  runtime/executor/batching.py: line 123
```

anya: interesting. PR #3216 touched selection heuristics. DEV: @marc any recent batching changes?

marc: no batching logic changes in that window. Only kernel heuristics in PR #3216 and a tiny telemetry tweak.

kai: quick bisect plan: try revert of PR #3216 locally and re-run the small-batch bench. If it regresses back down, PR is suspect.

devon: if we need to revert, can we do a canary against dedicated pool? I can spin a dedicated job that only hits that sha.

marc: go ahead, but first confirm with bisect. devon, can you run the nightly bench with the revert? command:```bash
git fetch origin && git checkout -b bisect/regression c7f9d2e~3 && git revert --no-commit <commit-hash-of-3216> && bazel run //bench:small_batch_seq -- --seq 512 --batch 4 --runs 10
```

devon: running now — will post results in ~30m.

ci-bot: artifact upload complete for job 1825001123 (bisect-run). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.local/artifacts/1825001123/

kai: ran profiler on bisect run. p50 is back to baseline when PR reverted. Flamegraph shows far less time in selection.py.

anya: that points to PR #3216 as the likely root cause. What exactly changed? marc, can you open the PR notes and add the allocation/profile context?

marc: #3216 changed fallback ordering for quantized kernels to prefer the new vectorized attention path for short sequences. Looks like for small-batch seq=512 it picks a slower path because branch condition mis-evaluates the sequence-length bucket. I'm pushing a quick fix to branch condition now.

tessa: if we push fix, do we want to rollback the release or patch? Ops: which is faster for minimal blast radius?

sre-bot: rollback window for this patch still open. Recommend a patch release to main with canary-to-dedicated validation.

marc: I'll open a hotfix PR and request review. Plan: patch kernel selection condition, run CI perf suite, then promote. If perf matches baseline, we'll backfill canary for dedicated.

devon: results from bisect run: p50 mean for reverted run = 124ms, original bad run = 142ms, baseline = 123ms. Numbers are noisy but consistent.

kai: I can run a quick AB test: current sha vs hotfix on a tiny dedicated pool for 1k requests to confirm.

marc: thanks. owners: marc (root cause & fix), kai (profiling + AB), devon (bisect+artifacts), tessa (infra signoff). I'll post a short summary in the morning once hotfix passes.

anya: rough ETA?

marc: hotfix PR in 10m, CI perf run ~20m, dedicated canary ~40m. I'll update thread. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: hotfix PR created: https://git.redwood.local/p/redwood/runtime/+/3321

marc: closing loop — hotfix green on perf CI, canary on dedicated running now. Will revert if any alarms in the next hour. Thanks all for quick turnaround. :tada:

kai: nice work. Follow-up: create a small unit test for the sequence-length bucket decision so this doesn't regress.

marc: adding test to hotfix branch before merge.

devon: leaving artifacts in case we need more digging: https://ci.redwood.local/artifacts/1825001100/, https://ci.redwood.local/artifacts/1825001123/

anya: great triage. Marking as resolved for now, will reopen if any perf alerts pop. :white_check_mark:
